# Kleis

Kleis is a modern, standards-compliant OpenID Connect (OIDC) suite. It consists of an OIDC Identity Provider (IdP) and a Next.js SDK.

## Core Features
- Standards Compliant: Full OIDC support with Discovery and JWKS endpoints.
- Edge Ready: Middleware and session logic built to run on the Edge.
- PKCE Handshake: Secure OAuth flow for single-page applications.
- Language Agnostic: Use the IdP manually via standard OIDC APIs.

## Documentation
- [Introduction](https://kleis.atharvdangedev.in/docs)
- [Next.js SDK Guide](https://kleis.atharvdangedev.in/docs/nextjs-sdk)
- [IDP Integration Guide](https://kleis.atharvdangedev.in/docs/idp-integration)

## Technical Details
- Identity Provider: Standalone OIDC server built with Express and Prisma.
- SDK: Lightweight Next.js integration using `jose` and `zod`.
- Security: PKCE, HTTP-only cookies, AES-256 session encryption.
